Re: Initial public offering of equity shares of face value of each ("Equity Shares") of LCC Projects
Limited (the "Company", and such initial public offering, the "Offer").
The Board of Directors meeting of our Company held on September 8, 2026, in consultation with Motilal Oswal
Investment Advisors Limited (the “"BRLM"), has finalized the allocation of 87,76, 869 Equity Shares in
aggregate, to Anchor Investors at the Anchor Investor Allocation Price of 146/- per Equity Share (including
share premium of 141/- per Equity Share) in the following manner:
No Bids were received from Mutual Funds and Pension Funds in the Anchor Investor Portion.

As per the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
2018, as amended, in case the Offer Price discovered through book building process is higher than the Anchor
investor Allocation Price, Anchor investors will be required to pay the difference by the Anchor investor Pay-in
Date as specified in the revised CaN.
Further, as per the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements)
Regulations, 2018, as amended, from time to time. we shall abide by Schedule XHH, Part A, Clause 10 and all
Al capitalized terms used and not defined herein sha!! have the respective meanings assigned to them in the Red
Herring Prospectus dated September 3, 2026, filed with the Registrar of Companies, Gujarat at Ahmedabad (the
"RHP") and the pre-Offer and price band advertisement dated September 3, 2026.
We request you to make the above information public by disclosing the same on your website.
